popup.title: Citadel Gate
popup.description: The city gate that separated [[Watch Citadel]] and its surrounding district from the rest of the [[Upper City]].

popup.title: Gond Gate
popup.description: One of the city's landmark "[[patriar]] gates."

popup.title: Manor Gate
popup.description: A landmark gate in the old wall that separated the [[Upper City]] district of [[Manorborn]] from the [[Lower City]] district of [[Bloomridge]].

popup.title: Sea Gate
popup.description: A landmark and one of the city's four, generally lesser well-known, "[[patriar]] gates" that connected the poor [[Lower City]] to the [[Upper City]].

popup.title: Baldur's Gate
popup.description: One of the oldest landmarks and the eponymous city gate that gave the famed port metropolis of the [[Sword Coast]] its name.

popup.title: Heap Gate
popup.description: One of the city's four, smaller "[[patriar]] gates" that connected the poorer [[Lower City]] to the affluent [[Upper City]].

popup.title: Black Dragon Gate
popup.description: Also known as the '''Landward Gate''', the grand northward gate that allowed a passageway through the northern wall of [[Baldur's Gate]], decorated with a large stone sculpture of a [[black dragon]] head that loomed over the inner side of the wall.

popup.title: Basilisk Gate
popup.description: The landmark gate lined with statues of prominent deceased [[patriar]], including one of [[Entar Silvershield]] placed above the gate in the 15{{th}} century [[DR]].

popup.title: Cliffgate
popup.description: A landmark gate that served as a passageway connecting the [[Lower City]] to the isolated district of [[Tumbledown]] in the [[Outer City]].
